items.title: Airbnb Cuts Recommendation Staleness from 2 Days to Seconds with Chronon
items.summaryShort: Airbnb Cuts Recommendation Staleness from 2 Days to Seconds with Chronon. Airbnb extended its Chronon feature platform with Push Mode and Near Real-Time Model Transform to update sequence-based recommendation embeddings within seconds.

items.summaryShort: Presentation: Wrangling Telemetry at Scale: A Guide to Self-Hosted Observability. Colin Douch shares battle-tested strategies for building and scaling self-hosted observability stacks.

items.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
items.summaryShort: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer. The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.
